method: Read every changed paragraph against saved pre-pass versions; check duplicated settings against canonical Methods, validation grid, full ViT confidence-interval table, and selection/statistics sections. No source edits or build performed by reviewer.

resolved_findings.issue: VOC tuning lost explicit ViT-B/16 scope although referenced grid includes multiple architectures.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current text explicitly says Every ViT-B/16 baseline configuration.

resolved_findings.issue: One-factor caption contained an incomplete grammatical splice around which the Factor and Value.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current caption separates Center definition from Factor/Value definitions.

retention_findings: Main quantitative comparisons, numeric scores, metric-specific limitations, runtime overhead, baseline identity uncertainty and source-table discrepancy are retained.

Removed repeated configuration recipes remain in the unchanged declared grid and Methods. Actual symbol meanings remain explicit, including relative SmoothGrad noise, DAVE rotation/shift/noise interpolation meanings, attention stabilizer, noisy gate and perturbation counts.

Qualitative loc configurations exactly match the full ViT CI table. Dataset-class targets, kuvasz prediction exception, first-test/five-validation provenance, raw-map preprocessing, nearest-neighbor TIBAV upsampling and shared signed 99th-percentile display transform remain explicit.

VOC target mapping, original-mask sliver exclusion, image-level disjoint split, seed, post-split empty-mask filtering, all image/record counts, mask resizing/cropping, transfer-vs-retuning asymmetry, record-weighted estimand and image-cluster intervals are retained. Nonsignificance is not equated with equivalence.

Attention tests retain tau values, float64, signed inputs, Value bias, positive epsilon, single-/multi-head layout, independent composite reference, sequential-rule distinction, merged-only release, complete trajectory enumeration and constant-attention residual comparison.
The runnable numeric-diagnostic command is semantically unchanged when converted from verbatim display to inline text.

Publication status, first authorship, reuse/reaggregation provenance, author contributions, OpenAI/Codex identity, all declared assistance categories and historical-vs-thesis distinction remain. Formal-verification coverage limits remain.

Validation matrix narrative and legend preserve rank-sum meaning, lower-is-better direction, fixed reference anchors, declared versus admitted grid distinction, fixed-method n/a and architecture dashes. Its numeric matrix itself is covered by a separate source-audit reviewer.
limitations: No LaTeX render performed. Numeric validation-matrix cell audit delegated separately by parent. No independent rerun of experiments.
